response_format: JSON object with book_code='2ES' and verses array. Each item has chapter, verse, text_ar, review_notes_ar. Return exactly verse numbers 71,72,73,74,75 in this chapter.

messages.content: ترجم الوحدات الإنجليزية إلى عربية فصحى أمينة. أخرج كائن JSON فقط بهذا الشكل: {"book_code":"2ES","verses":[{"chapter":1,"verse":1,"text_ar":"النص المترجم","review_notes_ar":[]}]}. انسخ أرقام الفصل والآية كما هي كأعداد صحيحة بأرقام 0-9 فقط، بلا فاصلة أو كلمة ملحقة، وعنصراً واحداً لكل وحدة.

{"verses":[{"chapter":16,"verse":71,"text":"They will be like mad men, sparing none, but spoiling and destroying those who still fear the Lord."},{"chapter":16,"verse":72,"text":"For they will destroy and plunder their goods, and throw them out of their houses."},{"chapter":16,"verse":73,"text":"Then the trial of my elect will be made known, even as the gold that is tried in the fire."},{"chapter":16,"verse":74,"text":"Hear, my elect ones, says the Lord: “Behold, the days of suffering are at hand, and I will deliver you from them."},{"chapter":16,"verse":75,"text":"Don’t be afraid, and don’t doubt, for God is your guide."}],"chapter":16,"book_code":"2ES"}
